Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug – 350ml

The Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug, Capacity: 350ml is designed for people who value style, durability, and everyday convenience. Crafted from premium stainless steel (most likely SS 304), this flask mug offers excellent resistance to rust, corrosion, and odour retention, making it ideal for daily use at home, office, or while travelling.

Featuring a sleek matte blue powder-coated finish, the Noir flask mug delivers a modern and vibrant look that stands out while remaining elegant. Its compact 350ml capacity makes it perfect for coffee, tea, green tea, herbal drinks, or even cold beverages. Designed for comfort and performance, this stainless steel flask mug is both functional and visually appealing.

Premium Stainless Steel Construction

Made from high-quality stainless steel (SS 304), the Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug ensures food-grade safety and long-lasting durability. SS 304 stainless steel is widely trusted for drinkware due to its non-toxic nature, excellent heat resistance, and ability to preserve the original taste of beverages. This reusable flask mug is an eco-friendly alternative to disposable cups and plastic mugs.

Modern Matte Powder-Coated Finish

The matte powder-coated exterior not only enhances the visual appeal but also provides a comfortable, slip-resistant grip. The smooth yet sturdy finish resists fingerprints, scratches, and daily wear, ensuring that your stainless steel flask mug looks new for longer. Its contemporary design makes it suitable for both professional and casual environments.

Ideal Capacity for Everyday Use

With a practical 350ml capacity, this flask mug is perfectly sized for everyday hydration. Whether you are commuting, working at your desk, attending meetings, or relaxing outdoors, the Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug fits easily into backpacks, handbags, and cup holders. It is lightweight yet robust, making it a reliable travel companion.

Available Colour Options

To match diverse style preferences, the Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug is available in four elegant Colours:

  • Black – classic and professional
  • White – clean and minimal
  • Grey – modern and versatile
  • Blue – bold and contemporary

Perfect for Multiple Uses

This stainless steel is suitable for a wide range of beverages including hot coffee, tea, cappuccino, green tea, and cold drinks. It is ideal for office use, corporate gifting, promotional branding, travel, gym sessions, and daily home use. Its premium finish and sturdy build make it a preferred choice for both personal and professional needs.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Product Name: Noir Stainless Steel Flask Mug
  • Capacity: 350ml
  • Material: Stainless Steel (Most Likely SS 304)
  • Finish: Matte blue powder-coated exterior
  • Durable, rust-resistant, and odour-free
  • Modern design suitable for office and travel
  • Available Colours: Black, White, Grey, Blue

Why Choose?

Choosing the Capacity: 350ml means investing in premium quality, timeless design, and sustainable living. Its stainless steel construction ensures long-term performance, while the matte powder-coated finish adds a refined touch. Designed to meet modern lifestyle demands, this flask mug combines functionality, aesthetics, and reliability in one compact form.

Whether you are looking for a stylish stainless steel mug for daily use or a premium for gifting and branding, the Noir Stainless Steel delivers exceptional value. Upgrade your drinkware collection with a product that reflects quality, durability, and contemporary design.
